scenarios.name: launch offers the controls and a tappable board
a blinker keeps three cells alive and keeps moving
a glider keeps five cells alive
a block is a still life and the scene says it stopped
tapping a cell toggles it, and a drag toggles a batch in one run
clear and random start a fresh generation zero
a bad cell or an unknown action is refused with a reason
a cell outside the board changes nothing
reloading mid-run steps on from the saved board
a hostile or malformed state neither hangs the module nor breaks the scene
